ceo.title: Message from the CEO
ceo.body1: We measure business success not only by economic indicators, but by the value we create for consumers and the long-term trust we build with our customers and partners.
ceo.body2: Since 1993, our business has grown to bring internationally recognised brands to consumers across Mongolia, while also developing brands that meet the needs of the regional market and the preferences of local consumers. We continue to expand the scope of our operations and grow steadily.
ceo.body3: We have also continuously developed our professional team and our standards-compliant logistics and distribution network. We pay particular attention to product quality, safety and availability, and strive to deliver reliable service that meets the needs of our consumers and customers.
ceo.body4: I would like to express my sincere gratitude to our valued consumers, customers, business partners and colleagues, with whom we create shared value through lasting cooperation and mutual trust.
ceo.name: Yaasim Maigul

intro.title: Creating <highlight>value in everyday life</highlight>
intro.lead: Cosmo Trade LLC is one of the longest-established companies in the import and wholesale of fast-moving consumer goods.
intro.body: Since our founding in 1993, for more than 30 years we have successfully supplied the Mongolian FMCG market with brands from Europe and Southeast Asia that compete on quality and standards. At the same time we develop our own brands, steadily broadening the range, reach and value of our products and services and making a real contribution to the growth of our industry.
intro.imageAlt: Cosmo Trade head office and warehouse from above

about.missionText: Our customers' satisfaction and happiness is our purpose
about.partnerText: If you want to bring your brand to the Mongolian market or sell our products, get in touch with us.
about.visionText: To be a reliable and trusted partner in Mongolia's consumer goods and distribution sector

people.title: Our people
people.text: We build a workplace based on mutual trust, respect and teamwork, and support every employee’s involvement, knowledge, skills and ambitions.

satisfaction.title: Satisfaction
satisfaction.text: We put the needs and expectations of our customers, clients and business partners first, and value long-term trust and lasting relationships.

quality.title: Quality
quality.text: We follow international quality and safety standards at every stage, from product selection and storage to warehouse management and distribution.

responsibility.title: Social responsibility
responsibility.text: We strictly follow the law and ethical principles, take our responsibilities to society, the environment and the public seriously, and are committed to sustainable development.

items.gifts: Gifts for holidays and special occasions

open.title: Open and transparent
open.text: Cosmo Trade LLC sees every employee as the company’s most valuable asset. We fairly recognise each person’s skills and effort, provide a good place to work and follow a transparent human resources policy.

salary.title: Competitive pay and rewards
salary.text: We give every employee an equal opportunity and recognise your effort with competitive, performance-based pay and a real rewards system.

career.title: Career growth
career.text: We develop our own people first, giving employees who lead with skill and initiative open opportunities to be promoted and move into management roles.

team.title: A positive, open team
team.text: A friendly, close-knit team built on mutual respect and trust is ready to welcome you.

office.title: A modern, comfortable office
office.text: A healthy, safe and comfortable workplace that supports productivity, fully equipped with the technology and tools you need.

balance.title: Work–life balance
balance.text: We respect our employees’ families and personal lives, offer flexible arrangements and fully support time to rest and recharge.
